synonyms: My Sickly Sister Always Misses Me
synopsis: Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?" (Source: Bilibili, translated)

synopsis: ♪ A loose and fluffy isekai reincarnation fantasy where the villain's son does his best to avoid ruin ♪ When I was selfish and laughing loudly, I (6 years old) remembered my previous life. Is this the world of RPGs? Moreover, I am the weakest of the three brothers, defeated by the heroes of the future, the so called "villain". I'm so unlucky. It's terrible. Confused, depressed, and worried, I made up my mind. First of all, let's stop being a villain! Be a good boy, get along with your beloved brothers and servants, and defeat the death flag! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Nibanme na Boku to Ichiban no Kanojo
titleRomaji: Nibanme na Boku to Ichiban no Kanojo
titleNative: 二番目な僕と一番の彼女
synopsis: Minamino Chinatsu is a beautiful girl who's incredibly popular and easygoing. Ever since I met her in the fall of my first year of high school, my life has been anything but ordinary. It all changed when another guy with the same name as me showed up at school – a handsome one, no less – and suddenly my classmates started calling me 'Number Two.' "You're not 'Number Two' to me," she said. "Besides, it's me who wants to kiss you first." My relationship with Chinatsu goes beyond just school. We play street basketball after class, cook meals together, share secrets, and even grow physically closer. I thought I was fine being alone, but she accepts me for who I am. And because of that, I want to give her the same in return. This is a coming-of-age love story about realizing how precious even the simplest desires can be. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
